grammar.summary: 本课学习情态动词推测（现在与过去的完整链条）。

points.title: must/may/can't 推测链
points.explanation: 肯定推测 must be；可能 may/might be；否定推测 can't be。对过去推测用 must have done / can't have done。

examples.en: It must be an abstract picture.

points.title: whether...or not 的让步表达
points.explanation: Whether they are good or not, ... 表"无论好不好"，whether...or not 让步结构。

examples.en: We like them in the same way.

exercises.q: I promise ___ I will help you.
You never told me ___ you had done to my computer.
I wonder ___ we will set out.
They don' t know ___ they will finish the work on time.
